entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: revised finish-reference lineup for Grave Accord. Preserve the exact seven adult survivor identities, face shapes, clothing silhouettes, signature equipment and left-to-right order from the reference: Soldier slate-blue cap/coat/pistol, Heavy ochre coat/belt gun, Tank rust coat/iron faceguard/shield/shotgun, Medic ivory hood/injector, Mage indigo robe/wand, Engineer teal apron/goggles/rivet gun, Assassin charcoal-burgundy scarf/needle launcher. CHANGE THE FINISH to detailed but exceptionally clean matte gouache and expressive dry ink. Maintain beautiful adult anatomy and expressive faces with deliberate detail in face, hands and one main prop only. Most coat and robe panels must be broad QUIET matte color areas with a few intentional folds. Remove the all-over scratched speckled crackle texture, repetitive gold scrollwork, tiny dangling trinkets and dense surface scratches. Three clear value masses per figure, warm bone light planes, no glossy gradients. Retain two or three meaningful outfit details rather than dozens of ornaments. These are professionally designed hand-painted game characters, not flat vector cartoons, chibi, 3D renders or photorealistic figures. Exactly seven complete separate figures in one horizontal row, generous transparent gaps with zero overlap, identical foot baseline, facing same three-quarter forward direction. Transparent background, no floor, no labels or text, no extra characters, no particles, no glows. Readable iconic silhouette at 56 pixels tall and attractive close-up detail. Original game's visual identity, simply cleaner and more intentional.
entries.review: Inspected full native source. Broad calmer coat panels, consistent seven class identities and signature equipment. Accepted finish reference; gameplay-scale review follows.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: expanded-roster clean-detail finish reference, exactly SIX full-body zombie bosses in a single row with large transparent gaps. Use the provided eleven-boss sheet ONLY for original Grave Accord civic-horror identity and gouache/ink palette. The first boss is the existing Hollow Constable: skeletal watch captain with watch cap, dark slate long uniform coat and one brass chest bell; preserve recognizable identity. The other five are distinct new bosses, left to right: 2 THE TOLLKEEPER, squat dead civic toll collector behind one enormous broad brass coin wheel, charcoal coat; 3 GLASS SURGEON, slender corpse doctor in simple ivory apron with one large translucent glass arm and surgical caliper; 4 CLOCKMENDER, hunched dead clockmaker with a single large exposed clock face in chest and two winding keys, dusty ochre coat; 5 CITY EATER, huge hollow undead torso whose massive clean rectangular jaw resembles a broken civic arch, stone-gray and iron-charcoal shapes, clearly corpse horror rather than robot; 6 HOURGLASS WIDOW, tall slim dead veiled woman holding one very large hourglass against a smooth indigo-black dress. Detailed but CLEAN expressive black ink and matte gouache: attractive deliberate anatomy, face/hands/ONE prop focal detail, broad untextured fabric planes, three major value groups per character. Remove all-over cracked/speckled texture and dense gold filigree. A few meaningful large seams, folds and distressed hems are enough. Strong different silhouettes, no costume clutter or miniature architectural detail. No particle haze, glow, explicit gore, floor, labels, words or frames. Transparent background, feet complete, clean wide gaps, no overlap. Highest finished original illustrated game-reference quality, readable at 150-pixel boss size.
entries.review: All six identities and signature props are clear, but coats and architectural body remain too mottled for the new clean-detail standard. Preserve as an intermediate reference; regeneration requested.

entries.prompt: Edit the SIX-boss reference sheet, preserving all six identities, proportions, pose, equipment and left-to-right order. Keep the Hollow Constable bell, Tollkeeper coin wheel, Glass Surgeon glass arm, Clockmender clock chest, City Eater rectangular jaw and Hourglass Widow hourglass exactly recognizable. The requested revision is an important surface-design change: make all cloth, armor and architectural body panels MUCH CLEANER and CALMER. Replace the all-over black mottling, cracks, speckles and random tiny distressed fabric marks with broad, largely UNTEXTURED matte gouache color fields and just 2 or 3 large intentional ink fold lines per cloth panel. No repetitive small detail outside faces, hands and ONE main prop. No skeleton-rib decoration covering coats. Use the provided seven-survivor sheet as the degree of quiet painted panel finish. Hand-painted 2D gothic game character design with expressive ink contours, not photorealistic, glossy or 3D. Keep adult scary undead faces and hands finely drawn, but 70 percent of each costume surface must read as simple uninterrupted painted shape. Preserve muted slate, ochre, bone and indigo colors. Clean silhouette edges, few large distressed hem cuts. Exactly six separate complete figures with wide transparent gaps, no overlapping feet, alpha background, no floor, text, glows, particles or extra characters. This is a readability refinement, not a change of boss identity.
entries.review: Full returned image inspected. The second finish replaces all-over crackle with broad smooth coat panels, preserving six distinctive identities and face/prop detail. Gameplay-size review is recorded separately.
